stations.title: Bryn
stations.say: Why was a local parcel charged more?

stations.title: Delivery code
stations.text: Lets any text through as a zone.

stations.title: Courier
stations.text: Charges by the zone the code gives it.

captions: Bryn asks why a local parcel from Oakhollow was charged as if it went abroad.
Someone typed Local with a capital, and the code took it as a zone it did not know.
You write types that allow a few kinds of value, and exactly those.
Now a zone with a capital is refused before the parcel goes out.
Zones, statuses and deliveries only take the words the shop really uses.
